notes: §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR2: 'Data-name-1 must be the name of a detail report group described in the same report as the control footing report group in which the SUM clause appears. Data-name-1 may be qualified by a report-name.' UponDetailRef screens the shape (no subscript or ref-mod, at most one qualifier) and ResolveUponDetail, called from ResolveReports, resolves the name through ReportGroupResolution.Resolve and refuses a non-group or a non-detail with COBOL2046 (the witness: UPON CFG). Probes at --std 85 (classes b, c, d): UPON DET, DET OF RPT, DET IN RPT and DET DET1B compile and total; UPON CFG, NOSUCH, DET OF RPT-FILE, DET(1), DET1B OF RPT2 and an empty UPON are refused. DEFECT: ResolveUponDetail accepts a detail of ANOTHER report and records it as a cross-report trigger (det.Owner = owner) at every edition: the 2023 relaxation (SR-13.18.54.3-7 dropped 'in the same report') is applied at 85, where SR2 forbids it. kb/Work PB5474 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read4/rd-01.json).

next.reason: 1985: "must be the name of a detail report group described in the same report as the control footing report group in which the SUM clause appears"; 2023: "Data-name-2 shall be the name of a detail. It may be qualified only by a report-name.". The 1985 UPON operand is 2023 data-name-2. The 2023 rule no longer requires the detail to be in the same report, nor the SUM clause to be in a control footing.
